summary: SqlCache.get now throws when a key is missing or older than 15 minutes, instead of returning an empty string.

findings.title: Missing key now throws and breaks the Cache contract
findings.problem: SqlCache.get now throws for a missing or stale key. Callers like readSession and isEnabled expect an empty string, as the Cache interface promises.
findings.consequence: main.ts passes a SqlCache to route, so any unknown session or unset flag throws inside the HTTP request handler. The uncaught error crashes the server process, and any anonymous request to /dashboard can trigger it.
findings.fix: Return an empty string for a missing or expired row, as the Cache interface promises. Alternatively, update every caller to catch the error.

findings.title: Expiry and miss behaviour have no covering test
findings.problem: The change adds a 15 minute expiry and a new miss path to SqlCache.get. No test file in the repository exercises either path.
findings.consequence: A regression in miss or expiry handling reaches production unnoticed. The crash in the finding above shows this risk.
findings.fix: Add tests for SqlCache.get with a missing key, a fresh row and an expired row.
